newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi stocks close lower in mixed trade.
newsitem.headline: Delhi stocks close lower in mixed trade.

text.p: Share prices on the Delhi Stock Exchange moved sideways before closing marginally lower due to absence of institutional support, brokers said.
The bourse's benchmark index closed 2.50 points lower at 719.74.
Brokers said selective selling by foreign institutional investors (FIIs) and mutual funds also put pressure on share prices.
"The market was jittery as buying support was selective and major investors were not seen involved in expanding their portfolios," said Ajay Thakkar of brokers Thakkar Associates.
ACC lost 13.75 rupees to close at 1762.25.
State Bank of India slipped 3.55 rupees to 250.75 on speculative selling, while Oriental Bank of Commerce gained 0.90 rupee to 65.65 on mild support, brokers said.
Larsen and Toubro eased 0.85 rupee to 232.75.
ITC bucked the trend and rose 7.85 rupees to 302.95.
